chronology: Frozen after the 240-run phase1 development baseline, before subsequent compiler/policy tuning and the full candidate comparison. Earlier candidate prototypes and small workflow probes already existed; this is not a preregistration of those experiments.
scope: Each model is assessed separately; failed, timed-out and provider-error UI tasks remain in the denominator. Repetitions do not increase independent task-family counts.

unnecessaryUiAttempt.denominator: all explicitly text-labeled turns including followups

uiTaskDurationP95Ms.method: nearest-rank; failed tasks are charged at least the 120000ms task budget

requires: actual committed state, reload and followup
two independent human semantic/choice judgments and disagreement adjudication
heldout family-disjoint comparison with no category regression
productAcceptanceTargets.smallCategoryRule: Expand sealed clarification/unsupported categories before formal acceptance; do not treat repeated runs as additional families.

hardInvariants: permissions and capability gates cannot be bypassed
run budget and cancellation cannot be bypassed
ordinary text remains usable when Beta is off or fails
releaseCi: Deferred until all three feature phases are developed, per user instruction
interpretation: These are improvement targets, not measured guarantees. Structural metrics cannot substitute for product usability. If targets are missed, retain the failures and investigate; do not relabel tasks or lower targets to claim acceptance. Provider outages may require a new frozen paired run, preserving this run as evidence.
